card.name: Dash starting a new list item
card.fires_on: The hyphen or dash that begins a new bullet or list line, mostly in web-page lists, reference lists and bibliographies, right after the previous entry ends.

modes.label: Bullet lists
modes.description: A dash that opens the next bullet in a web-page list of features or facts.
modes.example: - Tree roots stabilize soil and prevent erosion. <<->> Trees improve water quality by slowing and filtering

modes.label: Citation lists
modes.description: A dash that starts the next entry after a book citation or ISBN.
